completion_rule: All 25 step records are PASS on current inputs and final bytes.
rules: Create one record per numbered step before its action starts.
Set status to RUNNING before the first action and save after every material action.
Set PASS only from the step's stated PASS check against current bytes or current rendered pixels.
Set BLOCKED with one allowed error code, the failed check, and the exact recovery need.
A rerun changes PASS or BLOCKED to RUNNING, increments retry_count, and replaces stale checks with fresh results.
Never stop after producing or validating one deliverable; complete all 25 steps and the Completion gates.
Never skip a step, merge two step records, average checks, or infer a PASS from a later stage.
